name: Slay (death)
body:
School necromancy [death, evil]; Level cleric/oracle 6, druid 7, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6

EFFECT

Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes
Target Restrictions selected

DESCRIPTION

The target of a wordspell with this effect word takes 10 points of damage per caster level, to a maximum of 150 points of damage. If this save is successful, the target instead takes 3d6 points of damage + 1 per caster level (maximum +15). A wordspell with this effect word only affects living creatures.
